studyName: Agent generated UI control vs source-backed HCI recommendations

tasks.prompt: Build a responsive product catalog with working sorting, filters and keyboard support.
Build an operational dashboard with keyboard-accessible quick actions and responsive layout.
Build a modal settings flow with save/cancel, keyboard navigation and focus return.

protocol.agent: Same pinned model/version, temperature and tool budget for both arms
protocol.control: Identical task text, no uiq HCI research recommendations
protocol.hci: Identical task text plus uiq research output from original baseline; capture exact advice
protocol.assign: Randomize arm execution order per task/seed. Use isolated worktrees and no shared generated artifacts.
protocol.reviewer: Blind reviewers to arm; rate rendered UX 1-5. Reviewer scores recorded after independent review.
protocol.outcomes: Record test success, browser runtime errors, task time, tokens, qualitative UI quality
protocol.honesty: Do not populate runs until actual agent executions exist. A template is not evidence.
